title: Plant Packaging Lines Benchmark: Line 1, Line 3 & Line 4 Specifications
content: Everest Brewing Packaging Facility operates 3 primary production lines: 1. Line 1 (Canning Line): Specializes in standard and sleek can formats, producing approximately 2,000 hL (hectolitres) per 8-hour shift at 86.5% target OEE. 2. Line 3 (Canning Line): Dedicated canning line producing approximately 1,800 hL per 8-hour shift for specialty and core volume brands. 3. Line 4 (Bottling Line): High-speed glass packaging line operating at rated speed of 1,000 bottles per minute (bpm), delivering between 800 hL and 1,200 hL per 8-hour shift. Total facility rated throughput across all 3 active packaging lines averages ~4,800 to 5,000 hL per 8-hour shift.

title: Clean-In-Place (CIP) Sanitization Protocols for Lines 1, 3 & 4
content: Full automated 5-step CIP loop must be run between brand changeovers or every 72 hours of continuous filling across Line 1, Line 3, and Line 4: 1. Cold water pre-rinse (10 min), 2. Hot caustic wash (2.2% NaOH at 80°C for 30 min), 3. Intermediate water rinse (10 min), 4. Acid sanitize rinse (0.5% Peracetic Acid PAA at ambient temperature for 15 min), 5. Sterile water final rinse until rinse water conductivity drops below 50 µS/cm. Verification is logged automatically in the CIP Historian system.

title: Line 4 Bottling (1,000 bpm) & Empty Bottle Inspector (EBI) SOP
content: Line 4 handles 341ml returnable glass bottles at 1,000 bottles per minute (bpm). Weekly maintenance requires lubrication of bottle carousel bearings and replacement of crown capping chuck seals every 500,000 bottles. Empty Bottle Inspector (EBI) optical sensors inspect bottle sidewalls, base, and finish to detect micro-cracks or residual liquid prior to filling to ensure 800-1,200 hL per shift output targets are sustained with zero quality defects.
